plain: Earn 1.5 points for every dollar you spend, 3 points per dollar at restaurants, 4 points per dollar on streaming services, and 60,000 extra points if you spend $4,000 within 3 months.
alt: Rack up 1.5 points on every dollar, triple points on dining, quadruple points on streaming, and a 60,000-point bonus once you spend $4,000 in your first 3 months.
frame_flip: Don't miss out on 1.5 points per dollar, 3x on dining, 4x on streaming, or the 60,000 bonus points you'd forfeit without spending $4,000 in 3 months.
reordered: Spend $4,000 in 3 months and get 60,000 bonus points, plus 4x on streaming, 3x on dining, and 1.5 points per dollar on everything else.
